response.sql:
WITH combination_counts AS (
    SELECT
        rm.ordervault AS order_reference,
        o.orderflow AS status,
        COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM riskandmargin AS rm
    JOIN orders AS o
      ON o.recordvault = rm.ordervault
    GROUP BY rm.ordervault, o.orderflow
),
shares AS (
    SELECT
        order_reference,
        status,
        record_count,
        record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS share
    FROM combination_counts
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        order_reference,
        status,
        record_count,
        share,
        share - AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS above_status_average
    FROM shares
)
SELECT order_reference, status, record_count, share, above_status_average
FROM scored
ORDER BY above_status_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A combination's share is its record count divided by the total risk/margin record count among matched orders with the same status; the status average is the unweighted mean of those combination shares.
